notes.title: Meow! Help in the Kingdom Just Got Even Better! 🐾
notes.content:
A brand new update has arrived to make your search for the hidden kittens even smoother! Thanks to the invaluable feedback from our amazing community of feline detectives, we’ve made a few key improvements:


 ✨ Help cooldown is now persistent: The cooldown timer for asking for help no longer resets when you enter castles or return to the menu.
 ✨ Improved help highlight: The highlight opacity has been increased, making it easier to spot those sneaky kittens.
 ✨ Color-friendly adjustments: The help icon now adapts perfectly when you change the game’s color palette. Cuteness and clarity for everyone!


A big thank you to all of you for your feedback and support! You’re the true heroes of this paw-some kingdom. 🐱✨

Keep sharing your adventures and suggestions — they help us make Hidden Kittens: Kingdom of Cats even more purr-fect! 🎮🐾

v1.0.0.7
